results.desc: 1 item (43 p.) ; 38 x 49 cm. folded to 38 x 25 cm Handwritten treatise on folded, unlined sheets of paper held together with two stitches of thread With an introductory dedication to L'Amiral Bergeret, signed "G. Mancel, Brest le 10 Juillet 1831."
